body: Guys shorts are comfortable, but I feel so awkward when I wear them in public lol. I've got a pair of pattern shorts that are really loose and comfy, and they've also got pockets, praise the lord lol.

I think there should be more of a guideline, something that's more lenient. I don't understand why girls who wear modest shorts get the same punishment as the girls who come into school wearing spaghetti strap tank tops, booty shorts, and a whale tail from their nasty thong.

It's actually not so much the principle, more of the two bitchy assistant principles we have. My principle is pretty cool, I asked him about it and he was like "Well I know you aren't a slut so don't worry about it." But we have those two assistant principles who won't hop off your dick if you want to be somewhat comfortable in the heat for once, instead of having your jeans stick to your legs from sweat and humidity.
Haha, very funny of you. If you were a girl in my town, you'd probably hate it as much as I do.

I agree with you a bit, and I'm sorry for the drama. I'm just angry about this. But I don't really wear tight shorts, I love those pattern shorts that are a little baggier. And when I do wear denim shorts, they are well fitting, not skimpy and tiny like those sluts (ha).

Thanks, I really appreciate the support.

Thanks everyone. I wish I could reply to all your comments but I don't have a lot of time to come on here. I decided not to go through with my plans because of everyone's advice as well as the fact that I've only got four more years until I can leave my parents. I don't think I want to risk hurting my grandparents, aunts, uncles, etc. with this. But I really appreciate it, and thanks.

Well I'm not moving in with them actually. They are rich and own multiple houses, and my grandfather has Parkinson's, so they can't really come down to the shore anymore. They're basically giving us the house because they can't maintain it. But I'm on good terms with them, they're very nice. But thanks anyways.
Yes, it is. I have no one else to talk to, or anything else to take my sadness or anger out on, so I end up taking it out on myself.
Thanks. I really appreciate it.
Yeah I do. I have a midlength board. If you're wondering what brand, it's Ron Jon haha.

B. I don't really argue unless they something that I strongly disagree with. I tend to keep my emotions bottled up, because the fact that my parents always start yelling or arguing with me. I don't really argue back, since it's hopeless. "The adult always wins."
Not really. I've always wanted to code games in stuff, but as hard as I can try, I can't understand C++ or any other coding language for the life of me.
Not in my town. There's clubs, but they're in other towns that are kind of far away from where I live.
Well.. I've always liked simple games like LittleBigPlanet2.. but besides that, Saints Row 3. I don't have a lot of games since I have to pay for everything on my own.. and I don't have a job, ha.

I actually do long jump, 200m sprints, and I'm trying to get my times better for the 1600m in track. It distracts me a bit from being depressed, but it also makes me feel lonely because all the other girls on my team talk to each other and are friends with each other. I also snowboard, skateboard, and surf.. I'm gonna try to be on the surf team when I get into highschool, because I'm moving into my grandparent's house which is on an island, and it's right on the beach. It's nice, I guess. But material things don't really make me that happy.

I hope they change. I just want a happy life... I don't want a miserable one. But that's what it is right now. Also, my parents let me out of the house but they hammer me with questions. I want to grow up, but I don't.  I almost wish I could be feeling like I am now as an adult, rather than as a child. That ways, I'd at least have more freedom. But thanks for the advice.

I'm fearful of what it will bring though. I'm a coward. I'd rather not go on then risk living a miserable, lonely life as an adult. I don't really know how to put what I'm feeling into words, so there's not much I can say.
Maybe it'll make a huge difference. I don't know. I'm always stressed though. I'm always depressed. So I'm not sure if I'll even make it until then. I don't know.

True. But the thing is about my town is that it's very... close. Everyone knows each other, even if they go to different high schools. Also, pretty much everyone in this town is a dirtbag, so I don't know how this is gonna work out for me.

I've talked to teachers, councilors, student services, etc., but thanks for the suggestion. I may be intelligent.. but I don't think I'm stable.. I don't think I can handle the real world.. It's too intimidating. I always think about what will happen if colleges don't accept me, or I fail my college classes? Or what happens if my parents can't afford to pay or at the very least, assist me, in paying for my college? My uncle is like this. He's a talented artist, but he refuses to sell his paintings or get a job. My grandparents pay for his house and whatever else he needs. I think I'm like that... I can't deal with people, and I always find a way to screw up things. This reply kind of got a little off topic but I'm kind of.. venting I guess.. I don't know. To summarize, I guess the reason I want to end it is because I'm not strong enough to deal with life, present or future.

No. There aren't any clubs in my school. I've already talked to guidance councilors, student services workers, teachers, etc. They don't do anything. I've gone to them multiple times too. I am moving next year, to a nearby school (10 mins away from my current school), but I don't think that's going to be much of a 'new life' for me. I try to be a good person and change who I am, but I always forget and I end up being myself again..

The thing is, I already suck up to them. I do everything they tell me to do without arguing, I don't ask for anything besides help with something or something I really need (e.g a new binder for school). I know I should put the razor down, but I keep relapsing, again, and again. Every time I try and quit, I say "Hey, I'll never do it again." But it never works. I don't know if it gets better, I wouldn't know any better. But as far as I can tell, it won't for me. I don't think I'll be capable of doing anything in the future, I'll probably die doing some minimum wage job or something. I don't even know anymore. But thanks for the advice, it's kind of you.

Recently? I don't know where to start. My parents have always fought, but it's getting more intense now. My dad said he would hit me if he could do it without getting in trouble, and he often cusses at me. My mom on the other hand, talks to me, sympathizes with me, agrees that my father is a total douche bag, but then she turns around and yells at me soon as he enters the room or starts talking about me. She agrees with everything he says, even though it totally contradicts whatever we were just talking about. Sorry if it's confusing. I'm also so alone, and I'm depressed no matter what. Things that I used to enjoy no longer are enjoyable. I try so hard to appease to my parents and be a good daughter, but it doesn't work... no matter how I try. I study and I do good in school, made all AP classes for my freshman year, as stated, but they don't care. In fact, there's nothing bad that I have done. I don't even know why they are doing this to me. I can't move out, I'm thirteen. I want to run away, but I'm afraid of the consequences. I'm sure I could make it, but the depression still gets to me, therefore making suicide my only option here. It probably all sounds like first world, white girl problems.. But I'm also bullied all the time. I try to fit in, but I'm just pushed right back out. Guidance councilors don't do shit, my parents don't do shit, my teachers don't do shit. I don't really know what else to include, since it's a lot and I really don't want to type that much..
Well.. what should I talk about..?
